# `msan` trace fixtures

Real, unedited sanitizer output (stderr) from already-fixed bugs in public projects. Regenerate with `python scripts/capture_sanitizer_fixtures.py --only msan`.

- Image: `localhost/nikasha-capture:latest` (ID `sha256:aff6361c9fde71a5a1e00db1d58322582dc6a607c792adefd40b877f4c1642b1`) built from `docker/capture/Containerfile`, base `registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44@sha256:b4488a77fd2b96513fc8c18b502df7fbf19dad9e77d9a430c0163c574654822c`
- Compiler in the image: `clang version 22.1.8 (Fedora 22.1.8-4.fc44)`
- Engine: docker, run through `nikasha.repro.sandbox.run_container`
- Each capture was checked: the fixed tag builds and produces no sanitizer report.

| Fixture | Project | Vulnerable | Fixed | Fix commit | Reference | Environment | Script |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `01-jq-check-literal.txt` | https://github.com/jqlang/jq.git | `jq-1.7.1` (`71c2ab509a8628dbbad4bc7b3f98a64aa90d3297`) | `jq-1.8.0` (`d23a7b9db932be706fecf5f4c9711fd4214bb64e`) | `96d19ca2eef4bed201c5b1175ed013bc3122a001` | https://github.com/jqlang/jq/issues/3316 | `CC=clang CFLAGS=-fsanitize=memory -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer CXX=clang++ CXXFLAGS=-fsanitize=memory -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer LDFLAGS=-fsanitize=memory MSAN_OPTIONS=exitcode=77` | `cp -r /src/tree /work/tree && cd /work/tree && { ( printf '#!/bin/sh\necho exported\n' > scripts/version && mkdir -p modules/oniguruma vendor/oniguruma && autoreconf -i && ./configure --with-oniguruma=no --disable-docs --disable-shared && make -j4 ) >/work/build.log 2>&1 \|\| { { grep -m 40 -E 'error\|Error\|No such file\|not found' /work/build.log \| cut -c1-300; echo '--- build log tail ---'; tail -c 2500 /work/build.log; } >&2; exit 125; }; }; for i in $(seq 1 1); do ( printf n \| ./jq . ) >/dev/null 2>/work/out; rc=$?; if grep -qF -- 'WARNING: MemorySanitizer: ' /work/out; then cat /work/out >&2; exit $rc; fi; done; cat /work/out >&2; exit 124` |
| `02-zlib-gzclose-next-in.txt` | https://github.com/madler/zlib.git | `v1.2.8` (`50893291621658f355bc5b4d450a8d06a563053d`) | `v1.2.9` (`2fa463bacfff79181df1a5270fb67cc679a53e71`) | `c901a34c92c4aa74028f541a9773df726ce2b769` | https://github.com/madler/zlib/commit/c901a34c92c4aa74028f541a9773df726ce2b769 | `CC=clang CFLAGS=-fsanitize=memory -g -O0 -fno-omit-frame-pointer CXX=clang++ CXXFLAGS=-fsanitize=memory -g -O0 -fno-omit-frame-pointer LDFLAGS=-fsanitize=memory MSAN_OPTIONS=exitcode=77` | `cp -r /src/tree /work/tree && cd /work/tree && { ( ./configure --static && make minigzip ) >/work/build.log 2>&1 \|\| { { grep -m 40 -E 'error\|Error\|No such file\|not found' /work/build.log \| cut -c1-300; echo '--- build log tail ---'; tail -c 2500 /work/build.log; } >&2; exit 125; }; }; for i in $(seq 1 1); do ( ./minigzip < /dev/null ) >/dev/null 2>/work/out; rc=$?; if grep -qF -- 'WARNING: MemorySanitizer: ' /work/out; then cat /work/out >&2; exit $rc; fi; done; cat /work/out >&2; exit 124` |
| `03-libjpeg-turbo-ppm-rescale.txt` | https://github.com/libjpeg-turbo/libjpeg-turbo.git | `2.0.90` (`4e52b66f342a803d3b8099b79607e3158d3a241c`) | `2.1.0` (`c23672ce52ae53bd846b555439aa0a070b6d2c07`) | `b1079002ad451aab896617098b6bcbaae1d967e4` | https://github.com/libjpeg-turbo/libjpeg-turbo/commit/b1079002ad451aab896617098b6bcbaae1d967e4 | `CC=clang CFLAGS=-fsanitize=memory -g -O0 -fno-omit-frame-pointer CXX=clang++ CXXFLAGS=-fsanitize=memory -g -O0 -fno-omit-frame-pointer LDFLAGS=-fsanitize=memory MSAN_OPTIONS=exitcode=77` | `cp -r /src/tree /work/tree && cd /work/tree && { ( cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=None -DENABLE_SHARED=0 -DWITH_SIMD=0 -DWITH_TURBOJPEG=0 && cmake --build build --target cjpeg-static -j4 ) >/work/build.log 2>&1 \|\| { { grep -m 40 -E 'error\|Error\|No such file\|not found' /work/build.log \| cut -c1-300; echo '--- build log tail ---'; tail -c 2500 /work/build.log; } >&2; exit 125; }; }; for i in $(seq 1 1); do ( printf 'P5\n1 1\n1\n\010' \| ./build/cjpeg-static > /work/out.jpg ) >/dev/null 2>/work/out; rc=$?; if grep -qF -- 'WARNING: MemorySanitizer: ' /work/out; then cat /work/out >&2; exit $rc; fi; done; cat /work/out >&2; exit 124` |
